236.description: Filmed from a boat, a sleek grey dolphin swims fast alongside the railing just under the surface of the deep blue sea. It then races ahead and leaps high out of the water several times, splashing back down tail-first.
phrases: to jump high into the sky
story: Our boat races a dolphin across the blue sea.
The dolphin jumps high into the sky and lands with a splash!
It wins the race, and it doesn't even have a motor!

461.description: Outside a shop with blue doors, two young people dress a white mannequin in a shirt and scarf and pose its arm up. A guy then stands next to it copying its raised-arm pose while they laugh.
phrases: to stand still like a mannequin
story: Two friends dress a mannequin in a shirt outside a shop.
Then the woman raises the mannequin's arm and wraps a scarf around its neck.
Her friend stands still like a mannequin, and she can't tell which one to carry inside!

62.description: A cartoon man with sunglasses and a moustache packs apples, a baguette, a sandwich and a water bottle into a big tan bag on a picnic blanket; an apple drops out, he picks it up, puts it back and closes the bag.
story: A man packed a big bag with food and a water bottle.
Then an apple fell out and lay near the blanket.
He picked up the apple and never dropped the bag!

7071.description: On the lawn of a grand country estate on a grey day, a smiling grey-bearded older man in a red velvet robe with a white ermine cape and a jewelled gold crown rides a muddy quad bike towards the camera, first holding his crown with one hand and then gripping the handlebars. He laughs as the quad splashes through a big muddy puddle, and mud and water spray from the wheels. Behind him stand large old trees and a pale stone mansion with tall columns.
story: Wearing his gold crown, the old king let a quad bike carry him across the lawn.
He rode it straight through a muddy puddle and laughed his head off.
Nobody bowed to the king that day, but he felt young again!

8055.description: A black-and-white ink illustration in the style of an old engraving. A large striped hot-air balloon floats among a few sketched clouds. A small man in a suit and tie hangs below it, holding the ropes with one raised hand while his legs dangle in the air. The balloon drifts gently up and to the side, and the man sways on the ropes. This is a balloon that is filled with hot air and can carry a person high into the sky.
story: A man hung from a balloon high in the sky.
He held on to a rope because there was no basket!
The balloon carried him all day, and nobody could land it!
